purpose: Teach: 菊地/平川/滝沢/小柴/志賀/齊藤/岸田/高崎

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと菊地さんの家にお茶しに行ったわ
lines.en: Sho, you and Dad went to have tea at the Kikuchis' place.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Gentle opening. Conversational tone — reporting what happened without fuss. Soft, present attention on her son.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとお友達の平川さんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I met Dad's friend Hirakawa while we were there.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Quick, genuine smile in the voice. Small boy pride at having something to report back. Natural, unforced enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「滝沢秀明の歌は懐かしい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad said he found that old Takizawa Hideaki song nostalgic.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective pause before speaking. Soft delivery. She's noticing something her husband felt — gently turning it over. Warm curiosity in her tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとノーベル賞の小柴博士の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I looked at a picture book about Dr. Koshiba who won the Nobel Prize.
lines.style: Animated, proud of what he learned. Clear and present — he wants her to know this mattered. Genuine six-year-old delight without strain.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「志賀直哉の小説を一緒に読もう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad said we should read a Shiga Naoya novel together.
lines.style: Reflective, almost wondering. She's listening to what her husband is suggesting — noticing the thoughtfulness of it. Warm, slightly admiring tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが「齊藤おじいちゃんに敬意を持って」って仰ってたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad said we should show respect to Grandfather Saito.
lines.style: Earnest, still processing something important. He's taking it seriously — there's a small weight to this, delivered without drama. Sincere and clear.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「岸田首相のニュースを観よう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad said let's watch the news about Prime Minister Kishida.
lines.style: Reflective, observant. She notices Dad engaging Sho in the wider world. Warm without commentary. Gentle phrasing — she's noticing, not judging.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと群馬県高崎の駅弁買ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I bought a bento box at the station in Takasaki, Gunma.
lines.style: Eager, bright wrap-up. Small triumph in his voice — the concrete detail of a day well-spent. Happy to report, ready to move on. Genuine six-year-old joy.
